name: Yellow Creek
description: Crossing the northern woodlands of the Republic is the Yellow Creek, renowned for its unique yellow-hued waters. Though curiously tinted, its waters are drinkable, immune to corruption, and impervious to diseases, curses, and poisons. This anomaly attracts alchemists, who attempt to harness its essence for potion-making. Local tales attribute the creek’s color to a great wizard, hunted by the Empire and slain by her lover, who had been transformed into a mindless Ironhand soldier. Her demise near the creek infused its waters with her golden life essence. Her ghostly image is rumored to dance atop the water during full moons. Some of the tales continue by claiming that she was not only a wizard but a demigod from another plane, arriving in Tanares to pursue aboleths that fled her hunt. She fell in love with a human, but tragically, her love story was manipulated by the aboleths, leading to her death and the creek’s divine tint. Yet, beyond legend, it is true that the creek stands as a barrier against a hidden aboleth colony in the forest’s southern region. These malevolent beings shun the creek’s waters, making the creek a natural shield for neighboring settlements, thus being the source of the myths about it. At the colony’s leadership is Abyllisoth, an ancient aboleth from the wizard’s plane, his arrival predating even the Ungods. Distinct from typical Aboleths who side with the Ungods, Abyllisoth loathes both sides of the divine conflict, aiming to obliterate all deities in Tanares. Unlike his cruel kin, Abyllisoth is calculating and subtle, favoring strategic manipulation and keeping his existence hidden. His colony does not attack land residents if not with a clear purpose. His endgame is to amass mystical power in the form of artifacts and knowledge, positioning himself for the inevitable final clash between gods and Ungods that he plans to manipulate, ensuring both sides are destroyed. As part of his strategy, he employs marsh goblins and kua-toas, gathering all sorts of magic items to ready himself for the day Tanares falls to his kind.
